Large open grassy areas surround and extend behind the residence, providing space for movement. Dense mature evergreen trees are present on multiple sides and may limit visibility and movement in some sections. Several small detached structures are located farther back on the property. Outdoor items and vehicles are present near the house and in the yard. The property is set in a more wooded area with neighboring structures nearby.
